# Sky Capsule — Starship Prompt

A minimal, capsule-style [Starship](https://starship.rs) prompt configuration with two visual styles.

## Preview

| Default | Apple |
|:---:|:---:|
| ![Default](image/starship-default.png) | ![Apple](image/starship-apple.png) |

## Requirements

- [Starship](https://starship.rs) — prompt engine.
- **JetBrainsMono Nerd Font** — required for correct icon and symbol rendering.
- A terminal emulator that supports Nerd Fonts.

> **Important:** Use **JetBrainsMono Nerd Font**, not the regular JetBrains Mono font. The Nerd Font version includes the extra glyphs required by this configuration.

## Installation

1. Install [Starship](https://starship.rs).
2. Initialize Starship in your shell using the [official guide](https://starship.rs/guide/).
3. Download and install [JetBrainsMono Nerd Font](https://www.nerdfonts.com/font-downloads).
4. Clone this repository:

   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/bogdantalant/My-config-Starship.git
   cd My-config-Starship
   ```

5. Choose your preferred variant: **Default** or **Apple**.
6. Copy its configuration to `~/.config/starship.toml`.
